output.description: Output file (matrix in affine mode; image in deformable mode, metric computation mode; ignored in reslicing mode)
output.title: Output

affine.description: Perform affine registration and save to output (-o)
affine.title: Affine

brute.description: Perform a brute force search around each voxel
brute.title: Brute Force Search

moments.description: Perform moments of inertia rigid alignment of given order (1 or 2)
moments.title: Moments of Inertia

reslice.description: Reslice images instead of doing registration
reslice.title: Reslice

inwarp.description: The input warp to be inverted
inwarp.title: Input Warp

outwarp.description: The filename for the inverted warp output
outwarp.title: Output Warp

outwarp.description: The filename for the root warp output
outwarp.title: Output Warp

n.description: The value of N for 2^N-th root
n.title: N

outjac.description: The filename for the Jacobian determinant output
outjac.title: Output Jacobian

jacobian.description: Compute the Jacobian determinant of the warp
jacobian.title: Compute Jacobian

metric_param.description: Parameter for the metric (e.g., radius for NCC)
metric_param.title: Metric Parameter

step_size.description: Step size for optimization (default = 1.0), may also be specified per level (e.g. 0.3x0.1)
step_size.title: Step Size

iterations.description: Number of iterations per level of multi-res
iterations.title: Iterations

fixed_mask.description: Fixed image mask (metric gradients computed only over the mask)
fixed_mask.title: Fixed Image Mask

gm_trim.description: Generate the fixed image mask by trimming the extent of the fixed image by given radius
gm_trim.title: Generate Fixed Image Mask

moving_mask.description: Moving image mask (pixels outside are excluded from metric computation)
moving_mask.title: Moving Image Mask

wncc_mask_dilate.description: Specifies that fixed and moving masks should be dilated by the radius of the WNCC metric during registration
wncc_mask_dilate.title: Dilate WNCC Masks

reference_image.description: Use supplied image, rather than fixed image to define the reference space
reference_image.title: Reference Image

ref_pad.description: Define the reference space by padding the fixed image by radius
ref_pad.title: Reference Padding

background.description: Value to fill missing values when mapping fixed and moving images to reference space
background.title: Background Value

input_transform.description: Specify transforms (matrices, warps) that map moving image to reference space

zero_last_dimension.description: Sets sigmas and NCC radius to zero in the last dimension for 2D/3D registration
zero_last_dimension.title: Zero Last Dimension

smoothing.description: Smoothing for the greedy update step (e.g., '1.732vox 0.7071vox')
smoothing.title: Smoothing

inverse_warp.description: Compute and write the inverse of the warp field
inverse_warp.title: Inverse Warp Output

root_warp.description: Compute and write the (2^N-th) root of the warp field
root_warp.title: Root Warp Output

warp_precision.description: Saved warp precision in voxels (default=0.1; 0 for no compression)
warp_precision.title: Warp Precision

noise.description: Standard deviation of white noise added to moving/fixed images when using NCC metric
noise.title: Noise

exponent.description: The exponent used for warp inversion, root computation, and in stationary velocity field mode
exponent.title: Exponent

svf_mode.description: Perform registration using the stationary velocity model
svf_mode.title: Stationary Velocity Field Mode

svlb.description: Use more accurate but expensive update of v in stationary velocity field mode
svlb.title: Stationary Velocity Field Mode (SVLB)

sv_incompr.description: Incompressibility mode, implements Mansi et al. 2011 iLogDemons
sv_incompr.title: Incompressibility Mode

initial_warp.description: Specifies the initial warp to start iteration from
initial_warp.title: Initial Warp

weight.description: The weight of the penalty term
weight.title: Weight

tjr.description: Apply a regularization penalty based on the Jacobian of a tetrahedral mesh
tjr.title: Tetrahedral Mesh Regularization

wr.description: Weight of SVF smoothness regularization term (default: 1000)
wr.title: SVF Smoothness Regularization Weight

ia_identity.description: Initialize affine matrix based on NIFTI headers
ia_identity.title: Nifti Header Affine initialization

ia_voxel_grid.description: Initialize affine matrix so that voxels with corresponding indices align
ia_voxel_grid.title: Voxel Grid Affine Initialization

ia_image_centers.description: Initialize affine matrix based on matching image centers
ia_image_centers.title: Image Centers Affine Initialization

ia_image_side.description: Initialize affine matrix based on matching center of one image side
ia_image_side.title: Image Side Affine Initialization

ia_moments.description: Initialize affine matrix based on matching moments of inertia
ia_moments.title: Moments Affine Initialization

affine_dof.description: Degrees of freedom for affine registration. 6=rigid, 7=similarity, 12=affine
affine_dof.title: Affine Degrees of Freedom

jitter.description: Jitter (in voxel units) applied to sample points (default: 0.5)
jitter.title: Jitter

n.description: Number of iterations for random search
n.title: Number of Iterations

rot.description: Standard deviation of random rotation angle (degrees) or 'any' or 'flip'
rot.title: Rotation

tran.description: Standard deviation of random offset in physical units
tran.title: Translation

search.description: Random search over rigid transforms before starting optimization
search.title: Random Search

det.description: Force the determinant of transform to be either 1 (no flip) or -1 (flip)
det.title: Force Determinant

cov_id.description: Assume identity covariance (match centers and do flips only, no rotation)
cov_id.title: Assume Identity Covariance

moving.description: The moving image to be resliced
moving.title: Moving Image

output.description: The filename for the resliced output image
output.title: Output Image

outmesh.description: The filename for the output warped mesh
outmesh.title: Output Mesh

reslice_surface.description: Fixed/output surface pair (vertices are warped from fixed space to moving)
reslice_surface.title: Reslice Surface

interpolation.description: Interpolation for the next pair (NN, LINEAR*, LABEL sigma)
interpolation.title: Interpolation Mode

reslice_background.description: Background (i.e. outside) intensity for the next pair (default 0)
reslice_background.title: Reslice Background

reslice_datatype.description: Data type for the next pair
reslice_datatype.title: Reslice Data Type

reslice_jacobian.description: Write Jacobian determinant image to outjacobian
reslice_jacobian.title: Reslice Jacobian

outmesh.description: The filename for the output mesh with Jacobian determinants
outmesh.title: Output Mesh

reslice_simplex_jacobian.description: Compute Jacobian determinant for a simplex mesh in fixed space
reslice_simplex_jacobian.title: Reslice Simplex Jacobian

reslice_mask.description: A binary mask for the fixed image; zero values will be overwritten with background
reslice_mask.title: Reslice Mask

metric_gradient.description: Write the gradient of the metric to file
metric_gradient.title: Metric Gradient Output

debug_aff_obj.description: Plot affine objective in neighborhood of -ia matrix
debug_aff_obj.title: Debug Affine Objective

dump_pyramid.description: Dump the image pyramid at the start of the registration
dump_pyramid.title: Dump Pyramid

dump_moving.description: Dump moving image at each iter
dump_moving.title: Dump Moving

dump_prefix.description: Prefix for dump files (may be a path)
dump_prefix.title: Dump Prefix

powell.description: Use Powell's method instead of LGBFS
powell.title: Use Powell's Method

float.description: Use single precision floating point (off by default)
